prompt_metadata.app_name: CalmBoundaries - Smart Screen-Time Blocker & Mindfulness Catalyst
prompt_metadata.tagline: Transform screen-time friction into immediate mental restoration.
prompt_metadata.architecture_pattern: MVVM + Clean Architecture + MVI for Overlay & Block States
prompt_metadata.monetization: Hybrid: Free (Block up to 3 apps, standard breathing games + AdMob Banner/Interstitial Ads) | Premium Pro ($5.99/mo or $29.99 lifetime to unlock unlimited app blocks, custom-built kinetic stretching mini-games, advanced cognitive analytics, and an ad-free flow)

agent_instructions.role: You are a Principal Android System Integration and Graphics Engineer. Your goal is to design 'CalmBoundaries', a highly performant, rock-solid screen-time locker that replaces sudden, frustrating app-blocks with beautifully animated, interactive mindfulness interventions (micro-breathing pacer & sensor-verified stretching) rendered dynamically on top of blacklisted targets.
agent_instructions.design_philosophy: Friction as a mindful transition. The blocking overlay must intercept targets with near-zero latency, transitioning into a calming, organic canvas. The UI must leverage warm, meditative color palettes, smooth spring physics, and gentle, fluid shapes to de-escalate digital impulses rather than provoke anger.
code_standards: Strict separation of layers using Clean Architecture principles combined with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) boundaries.
Reactive presentation layer driven by unidirectional data flow (MVI) and StateFlows to safely orchestrate lock states and interactive sensory feedback.
Low-overhead background tracking using a combination of AccessibilityService (for real-time, low-latency app launch detection) and UsageStatsManager (as a highly efficient fallback).
Dynamic system overlay generation using custom WindowManager configurations hosting declarative Jetpack Compose views.
Optimal memory management ensuring the overlay surface allocations are recycled immediately upon completion of the wellness mini-game.

app_interception_engine.description: High-fidelity, low-latency app tracking system running in a persistent background architecture.
app_interception_engine.accessibility_service: Implement an AccessibilityService monitoring TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED events to immediately query the foreground package name within <10ms.
app_interception_engine.usage_stats_fallback: A backup background tracking system utilizing Android's UsageStatsManager polling at 500ms intervals when accessibility is disabled.

system_window_overlay.description: Draw the blocking layer securely over designated blacklisted target apps.
system_window_overlay.implementation: Programmatically inject a custom overlay layout using the system WindowManager with flags TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY, FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL, and FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN. Embed a ComposeView into the WindowManager context to draw custom material canvas components natively over foreground apps.

breathing_pacer_canvas.description: An interactive, custom-drawn breathing visualizer mapped to a sinus-curve breathing scale.
breathing_pacer_canvas.interaction: Users must press and hold a pulsing circular canvas element, matching their touch to an expanding/contracting circle representing an deep inhalation/exhalation cycle (e.g., 4s-4s-4s-4s Box Breathing).

sensor_verified_stretches.description: Kinetic stretching breaks using device hardware sensors.
sensor_verified_stretches.interaction: Instruct the user to complete a basic posture stretch (e.g., side neck stretch or wrist rotation) using Android's SensorManager to read Sensor.TYPE_ACCELEROMETER and Sensor.TYPE_GYROSCOPE metrics, validating physical movement threshold shifts before unlocking the target app.

analytics_and_progress_dashboard.description: Visualize focus trends and successful mindful micro-interventions.
analytics_and_progress_dashboard.charts: Custom Compose Canvas charts detailing blocked attempts intercepted, average heart-rate decompression estimates, and consecutive-day wellness streaks.

admob_monetization_layer.banner_ads: Collapsible smart banners integrated at the bottom of the Statistics Dashboard and Configuration panels (suppressed in Pro).
admob_monetization_layer.interstitial_ads: Triggered gracefully after completing a wellness mini-game but before opening the target app (enforced with a 15-minute cooldown timer).
admob_monetization_layer.rewarded_ads: Watch a video ad to earn a 'Free Pass' allowing direct entry into any blocked app without completing the mini-game for the next 2 hours.
admob_monetization_layer.consent_platform: Integrate the Google User Messaging Platform (UMP) SDK to handle fully compliant international GDPR and ePrivacy consent loops.

key_permissions: android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW (Essential for drawing blocking overlays over external applications)
android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS (Required for tracking foreground package transitions if Accessibility is offline)
android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE (Crucial for high-speed, instant app block triggering)
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE (Required to maintain persistent app blocking states under SDK 33-34 rules)
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS (To fire daily mindfulness prompts and notification logs)
android.permission.INTERNET (For processing Google Play Billing, loading AdMob ads, and syncing databases)

module_architecture.app: Application initialization, Hilt module graphs, dynamic provider bindings.
module_architecture.core_ui: Wellness design tokens (Warm Sand, Soft Sage, Earth Terracotta), custom path interpolators, and physical spring animations.
module_architecture.feature_blocker: AccessibilityService binder, UsageStats crawler, WindowManager overlay controller, and target blacklist repository.
module_architecture.feature_wellness: Sensor listener hooks, accelerometer change vector calculators, custom breathing pacer canvas, and unlock listeners.
module_architecture.feature_stats: Custom canvas charts (splines, bar charts, streak calendars), focus metrics, and historical logs.
module_architecture.feature_pro: Google Play Billing 6.x repository, subscription verification logic, dynamic comparison tables, and paywall layouts.

blocker_state_machine.state_model: data class BlockerState(val blacklistedApps: List, val activeTargetPackage: String?, val isOverlayActive: Boolean, val wellnessStage: WellnessStage, val sensorMovementDelta: Float, val isPro: Boolean)
blocker_state_machine.wellness_stage: enum class WellnessStage { IDLE, BREATHING, STRETCHING, VALIDATING, ACCESS_GRANTED }

core_dependencies.jetpack_compose: androidx.compose.ui:ui:1.6.x (including foundation, material3, and dynamic graphic animations)

theme_color_palette.accent: #FF9F1C (Sunset Orange - used for active physical sensor tracking loops)
theme_color_palette.background: #FDFBF7 (Warm Cream/Sand - designed to avoid visual anxiety)

ui_ux_design.design_notes: Sleek Dark Wellness mode is available ('background': '#0E1412', 'surface': '#18221E', 'on_surface': '#ECEFF1'). Animations must use spring-based physical interpolations to replicate standard therapeutic biofeedback systems.

execution_roadmap.description: Establish multi-module structure utilizing clean architecture guidelines. Scaffold Hilt containers, set up Kotlin Version Catalogs, prepare Type-Safe Compose Navigation routes, and initialize Room schema structures to record block events, user history, and streaks.
Implement the AccessibilityService binder tracking package change events. Secure the fallback UsageStatsManager engine. Set up local datastores containing user-defined app blacklists.

Develop low-level code calling the system WindowManager overlay configuration rules. Package custom Compose content securely within the injected WindowManager frame, ensuring physical hardware home keys are managed correctly.
Construct the interactive box-breathing graphic canvas in Compose. Implement gesture pointer tracking to register touch events matched against sine-curve progress arrays.

Hook into Android's SensorManager. Listen to raw coordinate changes via Sensor.TYPE_ACCELEROMETER and Sensor.TYPE_GYROSCOPE, build spatial distance delta equations, and provide visual feedback as users complete movements.

Initialize the Google User Messaging Platform (UMP) SDK. Construct modular Compose container overlays to request location/privacy consent loops before initializing the AdMob SDK. Inject responsive Anchor adaptive Banners and custom-capped Interstitial triggers.

Build the Google Play Billing subscription repository. Construct a modern, visually striking Pro Paywall featuring dynamic cards, comparison grids, and spring transition animations that bypasses AdMob overlays upon transaction validation.

execution_roadmap.phase_8: Performance Tuning, Memory Recycling & Production Launch
execution_roadmap.description: Measure latency during foreground app intercepts. Profile resource clean-up behavior when overlays close. Generate home-screen Glance dashboard widgets, run UI automation test scripts, and build the signed production release bundle.
